parameters.name: DtsJobIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking tasks.
> - You can specify up to 10 task IDs, separated by commas (,).
- You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the DTS task IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: A special parameter for specific business scenarios. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description: A special parameter for specific business scenarios. You do not need to configure this parameter.
